headline: Backup Report for Smith County Homes
summary: Smith County has a high outlook for long power outages of 12 hours or more. Records from the past 8 years since 2018 show a long outage about once every 4 years. In a big storm on June 2 2024 about 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 47 hours. Another storm on January 30 2023 hit 33% of homes in the county. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 58 hours. One Core lasts about 17 hours in August. One Core lasts about 43 hours in February. Two Cores last about 34 hours in August. Two Cores cover 91% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
